words.note: 最常見、最自然的替換之一；當 invite 表示請某人參加活動、做某事或前來某地時，ask 很常用，但通常需要補充具體內容，例如 ask someone to...。
words.example: We asked several colleagues to join us for dinner.
words.exampleZh: 我們邀請了幾位同事和我們一起吃晚飯。

exercises.original: We invited several colleagues to join us for lunch.
exercises.zh: 我們邀請了幾位同事和我們一起吃午飯。
exercises.upgrade: ask · 邀請；請求參與

options.explanation: ordered = 會變成命令同事參加。
demanded = 語氣太強，而且結構也不自然。
ask = 日常請同事加入 lunch，用 ask someone to join 很自然。
summoned = 帶權威或強制意味。
attended = 角色方向相反，是受邀者出席。
welcomed = 表示歡迎，但不是發出邀請本身。

exercises.original: She invited me to speak at the workshop.
exercises.zh: 她邀請我在工作坊發言。
exercises.upgrade: ask · 邀請；請求參與

options.explanation: ordered = 表示我必須發言。
summoned = 通常指叫某人到場，不是請其作 presentation。
welcomed = 不是邀請發言。
ask = ask someone to speak 是自然的邀請／請求結構。
attended = 不合主動邀請結構。
requested for = 語法不自然。

exercises.original: The committee invited experts to comment on the proposal.
exercises.zh: 委員會邀請專家評論這項建議。
exercises.upgrade: ask · 邀請；請求參與

options.explanation: demanded = 過強。
summoned = 不一定要求專家實際到場。
welcomed = 可 welcome comments，但主動向 experts 發出邀請更自然是 asked。
attended = 不合。
ask = 請專家提供 comments 是自願性的正式請求，因此 asked 最貼切。
ordered = 改變自願性。

words.note: 非常正式、書面化，表示正式要求某人出席典禮、會議或重要場合。
words.example: The organizers requested the presence of all award recipients at the ceremony.
words.exampleZh: 主辦方正式邀請所有得獎者出席典禮。

exercises.original: The organizers invited all award recipients to attend the ceremony.
exercises.zh: 主辦方正式邀請所有得獎者出席典禮。
exercises.upgrade: request the presence of · 正式邀請出席

options.explanation: summoned = 會帶有強制／權威意味。
ordered = 明顯是命令。
welcomed = 不夠表達正式邀請程序。
request the presence of = award ceremony 的正式邀請可用 request the presence of。
asked over = 太口語且通常到家中。
encouraged = 力度太弱，不是正式出席邀請。

exercises.original: The letter invited the ambassador to the opening reception.
exercises.zh: 信函正式邀請大使出席開幕酒會。
exercises.upgrade: request the presence of · 正式邀請出席

options.explanation: asked along = 太口語。
had over = 不合正式外交場合。
welcomed = 不是發信邀請的動作。
ordered = 不合禮節。
request the presence of = 正式信函邀請重要賓客出席，可自然用 requested the presence of。
summoned = 過於強制。

exercises.original: The invitation invited members of the board to attend the annual dinner.
exercises.zh: 邀請函正式邀請董事會成員出席周年晚宴。
exercises.upgrade: request the presence of · 正式邀請出席

options.explanation: encouraged = 不夠正式具體。
summoned = 不適合晚宴。
asked over = 太口語。
welcomed = 不等同發出邀請。
ordered = 不合。
request the presence of = 正式 invitation 文體中，requested the presence of 是典型用語。

words.note: 當 invite 的重點是讓某人感到受歡迎、鼓勵加入或進入某空間時可用；不等於所有正式邀請。
words.example: Visitors are welcome to join the guided tour.

exercises.original: We invite visitors to join the guided tour at 2 p.m.
exercises.zh: 我們歡迎訪客下午兩時參加導賞團。
exercises.upgrade: welcome · 歡迎；邀請加入

options.explanation: order = 不合自願參加。
summon = 過強。
demand = 過強。
attend = 不能由主辦方作及物邀請用。
welcome = 這裡是公開、友善地鼓勵 visitors 加入，因此 welcome 很自然。
ask over = 不是到家作客。

exercises.original: The museum invites families to explore the new gallery.
exercises.zh: 博物館歡迎家庭參觀新展廳。
exercises.upgrade: welcome · 歡迎；邀請加入

options.explanation: summons = 完全不合公開參觀語境。
orders = 不是命令。
requests = 可以請求，但語氣不如 welcomes 自然。
asks over = 只適合私人住處。
calls on = 通常是請某人發言／行動。
welcome = 公共機構對 visitors 表達友善接納時，welcomes 最貼切。

exercises.original: The programme invites applications from recent graduates.
exercises.zh: 這項計劃歡迎應屆畢業生申請。
exercises.upgrade: welcome · 歡迎；邀請加入

options.explanation: welcome = welcomes applications 是很自然的公開招募表達。
orders = 不合。
summons = 不合。
attends = 不合。
asks over = 不合。
bids = 語體過舊，而且不適合 applications。

words.note: 描述性說法，直接表示請某人加入活動、團體或聚會。
words.example: She asked me to join the team for the weekend event.
words.exampleZh: 她邀請我加入團隊參加週末活動。

exercises.original: She invited me to join the project team.
exercises.zh: 她邀請我加入項目團隊。
exercises.upgrade: ask to join · 邀請加入；請參與

options.explanation: ordered me to join = 會改變成強制。
summoned me to join = 不自然。
welcomed me to join = 也可，但較像接納而非直接發出邀請。
attended me to join = 語法錯誤。
demanded me to join = 語法及語氣都不合。
ask to join = 直接請某人加入 team，asked me to join 最自然。

exercises.original: They invited us to join them for dinner after the meeting.
exercises.zh: 會議後他們邀請我們一起吃晚飯。
exercises.upgrade: ask to join · 邀請加入；請參與

options.explanation: ask to join = ask someone to join someone for dinner 是自然社交邀請。
ordered us to join = 過強。
summoned us = 不合社交晚餐。
welcomed us = 表示歡迎但少了 invitation action。
called on us = 通常表示請發言／行動。
requested us for dinner = 結構不自然。

exercises.original: The club invited new students to join the weekend trip.
exercises.zh: 社團邀請新生參加週末旅行。
exercises.upgrade: ask to join · 邀請加入；請參與

options.explanation: demanded = 不是強制活動。
ask to join = 社團請新生參加 trip，用 asked ... to join 很自然。
summoned = 不合。
welcomed = 可以表示歡迎參加，但主動邀請用 asked 更直接。
ordered = 不合。
attended = 角色錯誤。

words.note: 較口語，特別指邀請某人到自己家中或住處作客。
words.example: We asked a few neighbours over for coffee.
words.exampleZh: 我們邀請幾位鄰居來家裡喝咖啡。

exercises.original: We invited a few neighbours to our house for coffee.
exercises.zh: 我們邀請幾位鄰居來家裡喝咖啡。
exercises.upgrade: ask over · 邀請到家中作客

options.explanation: ask over = 邀請鄰居到自己家喝咖啡，口語固定說 ask someone over。
summoned = 不合私人社交。
called on = 意思會變成拜訪或請發言。
ordered = 過強。
welcomed = 可以在他們到達時 welcome，但不是邀請動作。
requested the presence of = 對喝咖啡太正式。

exercises.original: She invited us to her apartment for dinner.
exercises.zh: 她邀請我們去她的公寓吃晚飯。
exercises.upgrade: ask over · 邀請到家中作客

options.explanation: called on us = 通常不是到家吃飯的邀請。
ask over = 私人住處 + dinner 是 ask over 的典型語境。
summoned us = 過強。
welcomed us = 是到達後的接待。
ordered us = 不合。
encouraged us = 不完整。

exercises.original: They invited some friends to their place on Sunday.
exercises.zh: 他們星期日邀請幾位朋友到家裡。
exercises.upgrade: ask over · 邀請到家中作客

options.explanation: requested their presence = 太正式。
summoned them = 不合。
ask over = their place 表示到家作客，因此 asked ... over 最自然。
called them on = 意思不同。
ordered them = 不合。
attended them = 不合。

words.note: 較口語，表示邀請某人到家中吃飯、聚會或作客；常見於英語日常會話。
words.example: We're having some friends over on Saturday.
words.exampleZh: 我們星期六會邀請一些朋友來家裡。

exercises.original: We're inviting some friends to our place on Saturday evening.
exercises.zh: 我們星期六晚上會邀請一些朋友來家裡。
exercises.upgrade: have over · 邀請到家裡；請來作客

options.explanation: summoning = 不合。
have over = have someone over 是很自然的口語家中作客表達。
requesting the presence of = 太正式。
calling on = 意思不同。
ordering = 不合。
attending = 角色方向錯。

exercises.original: They invited the neighbours for dinner last night.
exercises.zh: 他們昨晚邀請鄰居來家裡吃飯。
exercises.upgrade: have over · 邀請到家裡；請來作客

options.explanation: welcomed = 表示接待，不直接等同整個邀請安排。
summoned = 過強。
have over = 邀請 neighbours 到家 dinner，用 had ... over 很自然。
called on = 通常表示拜訪／請發言。
ordered = 不合。
encouraged = 不合。

exercises.original: We often invite family to our home during the holidays.
exercises.zh: 假日期間我們常邀請家人來家裡。
exercises.upgrade: have over · 邀請到家裡；請來作客

options.explanation: summon = 不合 family gathering。
request the presence of = 過於正式。
call on = 不是招待到家。
have over = 家庭聚會中讓 family 到家作客，have ... over 是自然口語說法。
order = 不合。
attend = 不合。

words.note: 在會議、課堂或正式討論中，可表示邀請某人發言、回答或採取某項行動。
words.example: The chair called on the finance director to explain the figures.
words.exampleZh: 主席請財務總監解釋數字。

exercises.original: The chair invited the finance director to explain the figures.
exercises.zh: 主席請財務總監解釋數字。
exercises.upgrade: call on · 邀請發言；請某人回應

options.explanation: asked over = 不是邀請到家。
had over = 不合會議。
call on = 會議主持人指名某人發言，標準說法是 call on someone to...。
welcomed = 不能完整表達 chair 指名發言。
summoned = 語氣過強。
attended = 不合。

exercises.original: The teacher invited Maria to answer the question.
exercises.zh: 老師請 Maria 回答問題。
exercises.upgrade: call on · 邀請發言；請某人回應

options.explanation: welcomed = 不合。
asked over = 不合教室。
had over = 不合。
call on = 課堂中老師點名某人回答，最自然是 called on。
summoned = 過於嚴厲。
requested the presence of = 不是請她出席。

exercises.original: During the discussion, the moderator invited two experts to respond.
exercises.zh: 討論期間，主持人請兩位專家回應。
exercises.upgrade: call on · 邀請發言；請某人回應

options.explanation: asked over = 不合。
welcomed = 較像一般接納發言，不突出點名。
summoned = 太強。
had over = 不合。
call on = moderator 在討論中點名 experts 回應，called on 最精確。
bid = 過舊式。

words.note: 當 invite 是較柔和地鼓勵某人參與、申請、提供意見或採取行動時，可用 encourage；語義比直接邀請更間接。
words.example: The survey encourages participants to share detailed feedback.
words.exampleZh: 這項調查鼓勵參加者提供詳細意見。

exercises.original: The organizers invite participants to submit feedback after the event.
exercises.zh: 主辦方鼓勵參加者在活動後提交意見。
exercises.upgrade: encourage · 鼓勵參與；邀請考慮

options.explanation: order = 會變成強制。
summon = 不合。
welcome = 可 welcome feedback，但結構和重點不同。
encourage = 面向所有 participants 作柔和、非強制的行動邀請，encourage 很自然。
ask over = 不合。
call on = 通常是指名某人，不是面向所有 participants。

exercises.original: The website invites users to create an account for additional features.
exercises.zh: 網站鼓勵用戶建立帳戶以使用額外功能。
exercises.upgrade: encourage · 鼓勵參與；邀請考慮

options.explanation: orders = 不是必須。
summons = 不合。
requests the presence of = 完全不合。
asks over = 不合。
encourage = 網站以非強制方式促使用戶採取行動，encourages 比 invite 更自然。
calls on = 較像公開呼籲，不如 encourages 適合 UX 文案。

exercises.original: The programme invites residents to share ideas for improving the park.
exercises.zh: 計劃鼓勵居民提出改善公園的想法。
exercises.upgrade: encourage · 鼓勵參與；邀請考慮

options.explanation: demands = 過強。
orders = 過強。
summons = 不合。
asks over = 不合。
welcomes = 可 welcome ideas，但若修飾 residents to share，encourages 更自然。
encourage = 公開促進居民參與，而非逐一正式發邀請，用 encourages 最貼切。

words.note: 當重點是熱情接納某人到某地、團隊、活動或機構時適用。
words.example: The department welcomed three new researchers to the team.
words.exampleZh: 部門歡迎三位新研究員加入團隊。

exercises.original: The department invited three new researchers to join the team.
exercises.zh: 部門歡迎三位新研究員加入團隊。
exercises.upgrade: welcome someone to · 歡迎某人加入／前來

options.explanation: summoned = 不合新成員加入。
ordered = 不合。
asked over = 不合職場。
called on = 意思不同。
welcome someone to = 新成員正式加入既有團隊時，welcomed ... to the team 很自然。
requested the presence of = 不是出席單一場合。

exercises.original: The university invited international students to campus at the start of term.
exercises.zh: 大學在學期開始時歡迎國際學生來到校園。
exercises.upgrade: welcome someone to · 歡迎某人加入／前來

options.explanation: summoned = 不合迎新語境。
ordered = 不合。
called on = 不合。
asked over = 校園不是私人住處。
bid = 過舊式。
welcome someone to = 學生已經到來或正式加入校園社群時，重點是接納，因此 welcomed 最精確。

exercises.original: The organization invited its newest members to the annual meeting with a short reception.
exercises.zh: 機構以簡短招待會歡迎最新成員參加周年會議。
exercises.upgrade: welcome someone to · 歡迎某人加入／前來

options.explanation: welcome someone to = with a short reception 表明重點是歡迎和接待，因此 welcomed ... to 最自然。
ordered = 不合。
summoned = 不合。
asked over = 不是家中聚會。
called on = 不是點名發言。
requested their presence = 會把接待重點改成正式邀請。

words.note: 正式、書面化，強調正式把邀請送給某人或某群體。
words.example: The university extended an invitation to local schools to attend the exhibition.
words.exampleZh: 大學向本地學校發出邀請，請他們參觀展覽。

exercises.original: The university invited local schools to attend the exhibition.
exercises.zh: 大學向本地學校發出邀請，請他們參觀展覽。
exercises.upgrade: extend an invitation to · 向……發出邀請

options.explanation: summoned = 不合教育參觀。
ordered = 不合。
asked over = 不是私人住處。
welcomed = 表示接納，但不如 extend an invitation 突出正式發邀請。
called on = 不合。
extend an invitation to = 正式向一組 institutions 發出 invitation，extended an invitation to 很自然。

exercises.original: The organizers invited several community groups to take part in the festival.
exercises.zh: 主辦方向數個社區團體發出邀請，請他們參與節慶。
exercises.upgrade: extend an invitation to · 向……發出邀請

options.explanation: extend an invitation to = 主辦方正式邀請 organizations 參與，extend an invitation 最精確。
summoned = 不合自願 festival participation。
demanded = 過強。
had over = 不合。
called on = 可公開呼籲，但不如 formal invitation。
welcomed = 不是發出邀請這個動作。

exercises.original: The museum invited the artist's family to the private opening.
exercises.zh: 博物館向藝術家的家人發出邀請，請他們參加私人開幕活動。
exercises.upgrade: extend an invitation to · 向……發出邀請

options.explanation: asked over = private opening 不是在私人家中。
extend an invitation to = private opening 的正式邀請最適合 extended an invitation to。
summoned = 不合。
ordered = 不合。
called on = 不合。
welcomed = 較像到場時的接待。

words.note: 較口語，常指邀請某人一起去某個活動、旅程或聚會。
words.example: I asked Maya along to the concert.
words.exampleZh: 我邀請 Maya 一起去音樂會。

exercises.original: I invited Maya to come with us to the concert.
exercises.zh: 我邀請 Maya 和我們一起去音樂會。
exercises.upgrade: ask someone along · 邀請某人一同前往

options.explanation: ask someone along = 邀請某人一起前往 concert，口語可用 ask someone along。
summoned Maya = 不合社交活動。
ordered Maya = 不合。
asked Maya over = 會變成邀請到家。
called on Maya = 意思不同。
welcomed Maya = 不表示一同前往。

exercises.original: We invited Daniel to come on the weekend hike.
exercises.zh: 我們邀請 Daniel 一起參加週末遠足。
exercises.upgrade: ask someone along · 邀請某人一同前往

options.explanation: had Daniel over = 不是到家。
ask someone along = 共同外出活動中邀請某人同行，asked ... along 很自然。
summoned Daniel = 不合。
ordered Daniel = 不合。
called on Daniel = 不合。
requested Daniel's presence = 對 hike 太正式。

exercises.original: She invited her cousin to come with the group to the festival.
exercises.zh: 她邀請表親和大家一起去節慶。
exercises.upgrade: ask someone along · 邀請某人一同前往

options.explanation: asked her cousin over = 會表示到家作客。
summoned her cousin = 過強。
ask someone along = 重點是邀請 cousin 一起前往活動，因此 asked ... along 最貼切。
called on her cousin = 不合。
ordered her cousin = 不合。
welcomed her cousin = 不完整表達同行邀請。

words.note: 較舊式、文學化或正式，可表示邀請某人前來或參與；現代日常英語較少用。
words.example: The king bade the guests enter the hall.
words.exampleZh: 國王邀請賓客進入大廳。

exercises.original: The host invited the guests to enter the hall.
exercises.zh: 主人邀請賓客進入大廳。
exercises.upgrade: bid · 邀請；請求出席

options.explanation: ordered = 可能過強；原句是正式接待。
bid = 在較文學、古典語體中，bid someone enter 可表示正式請某人進入。
summoned = 不是叫人前來受命。
asked over = 不合。
called on = 不合。
welcomed = 可表達接待，但不保留較舊式『請進』結構。

exercises.original: The king invited the visitors to sit beside the fire.
exercises.zh: 國王請訪客坐到火爐旁。
exercises.upgrade: bid · 邀請；請求出席

options.explanation: summoned = 不是叫人到場。
ordered = 可能太強硬。
bid = 歷史或文學敘事中，bade ... sit 是自然的舊式表達。
asked over = 不合。
welcomed = 不直接接 sit 這種命令式補語。
encouraged = 語氣不同。

exercises.original: The hostess invited everyone to begin the meal.
exercises.zh: 女主人請大家開始用餐。
exercises.upgrade: bid · 邀請；請求出席

options.explanation: summoned = 不合。
ordered = 會增加強制感。
asked over = 不合。
bid = 較古典、正式地表示『請大家開始』可用 bade。
called on = 通常是點名發言。
welcomed = 不合 begin the meal 的結構。

falseSynonyms.zh: 命令不等於邀請 order 表示要求對方必須做某事；invite 通常保留對方選擇是否接受的自由。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON An invitation can be declined; an order is meant to be obeyed.

falseSynonyms.zh: 要求不等於邀請 demand 語氣強，表示堅持要求某事；invite 通常較禮貌且非強制。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON You may invite someone to speak, but demanding that they speak is much stronger.

falseSynonyms.zh: 傳召不等於一般邀請 summon 表示正式要求某人到場，常帶權威或強制意味；一般社交邀請不適合用。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A court may summon a witness; a host invites a guest.

falseSynonyms.zh: 請求不一定等於邀請 request 是一般請求；只有在請求某人出席、加入或前來時，才可能和 invite 接近。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON You can request information, but you invite a person to an event.

falseSynonyms.zh: 歡迎不完全等於邀請 welcome 重點是接納和表示樂意某人到來；invite 重點是主動發出邀請。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON You may invite someone first and welcome them when they arrive.

falseSynonyms.zh: 動詞與名詞不同 invite 是動詞；invitation 是名詞。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON They invited us to dinner. We accepted the invitation.

falseSynonyms.zh: 邀請與索取不同 ask someone to... 可表示邀請或請求；ask for 通常表示索取某物。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON She asked me to join. She asked for more information.

falseSynonyms.zh: 出席與邀請不同 attend 是受邀者參加活動；invite 是主辦方發出邀請。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON They invited us to the conference, and we attended.
